notes.q1_coverage_method: Denominator = non-test source files under src/ (find src -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) ! -name '*.test.ts' ! -name '*.test.tsx' | wc -l = 177). Coverage = 59/177 = 33.3%. Prior denominators (118, 160) had no recorded command and were not reproducible; this definition replaces them and is recomputed from files each cycle. File-level coverage >=80% is mathematically unreachable under the 80-term budget cap (would require ~142 terms); the consolidation policy (129->59) deliberately trades file-count coverage for concept-level coverage of domain entities/services/architecture, per the bloat-control principle (prefer consolidation over growth).
notes.cycle_228_quality_repair: Fixed 4 integrity defect groups found by cycle-227 review: (1) added status/strength to 32 invariants that lacked both, using the established severity convention (CRITICAL/HIGH=hard, MEDIUM=soft, all stable) — counts now reconcile (hard 79 + soft 21 = stable 100); (2) replaced 10 placeholder test-evidence quotes in term_queue.yml with actual quoted describe() lines and line refs from the referenced test files; (3) reclassified 5 ontology terms from non-schema layer 'application' to 'domain' (AuthorizationService TERM-122, AuditService, BackupService, NotificationService, TrendAnalysisService), matching the established convention that service terms live in domain; (4) recomputed this metrics file from actual file state.
